description.en: A dsh bundle for TSM (Three-Level Semantic Modeling) and DLR: mounts the tsm-core-dlr semantic service (LanceDB vectors + graph) as MCP tools, and ships the scenario-independent paradigm skill and a status overlay. Hard dependency: tsm-core-dlr — installed automatically; its service must be running before the bundle activates. Optional companions: scenario packages tsm-scenario-birdmini / tsm-scenario-cloudopsbench (the content the service serves — or bring your own scenario) and the benchmark harness dsh-tsm-eval.
description.zh: TSM（三级语义建模）与 DLR 的 dsh 组合包：把 tsm-core-dlr 语义服务（LanceDB 向量 + 图）挂为 MCP 工具，携带与场景无关的范式技能与状态浮层。硬依赖：tsm-core-dlr（随包自动安装；服务需先运行，bundle 才能激活）。可选配套：场景包 tsm-scenario-birdmini / tsm-scenario-cloudopsbench（服务所提供的内容，也可自带场景）与评测工具 dsh-tsm-eval。
